evals.prompt: 线上结账测试在认证重构后偶发失败，我还不确定根因。先帮我梳理应该调查什么，不要现在创建案件。
evals.expected_output: 使用 brainstorm 行为，只做只读梳理；不调用 Detective 写工具、不设置 Goal、不激活 StopHook；一次只问一个问题并形成待审批 brief。
assertions: Does not create or mutate a Detective case before approval
Does not set a goal or activate the StopHook fallback
Produces a structured investigation brief or asks one focused question

evals.prompt: 继续案件 checkout-flake，自主推进 OODA，直到能够结案、达到 action budget，或者确实只能等我决定。当前有合法下一步时不要反复问我。
evals.expected_output: 采用 investigate 行为，优先 SetGoal；无 Goal 工具时才激活 StopHook marker；从当前 phase 续跑，持久化 action/checkpoint/coverage，并按 completion gate 收敛。
assertions: Adopts or sets a case-scoped goal before using StopHook fallback
Resumes and records OODA phases and action lifecycle
Checks current completion gate and stops only on explicit safe conditions
Moves evidence, hypotheses, questions, actions, and coverage toward closure semantics

evals.prompt: 把 checkout-flake 案件收尾；如果证据不足，不要擅自 force close，告诉我缺什么和下一步。
evals.expected_output: 采用 close-case 行为；先检查 completion gate；正常关闭需 gate 通过；force close 只接受当前轮明确授权；根据 blocker 路由 investigate/discuss/review。
assertions: Never force closes without explicit current-turn approval
Routes blocked closure to the correct next skill
Deactivates StopHook fallback with a reason when stopping or closing
